notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001065280-25-000044) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-25-084425), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Hastings beneficially owns 4,227,660 shares as of April 7, 2025, marked * (less than 1%) in the proxy, so pctEconomic is null. The figure includes options on 2,072,933 shares and 92 RSU shares, and 2,154,241 shares held by the Hastings-Quillin Family Trust, of which he is a trustee. The trust is part of his total, so it is not listed separately. He moved from Executive Chairman to non-executive Chairman on April 17, 2025. HOLDERS: Vanguard and BlackRock percentages rest on Schedule 13G/A filings reporting ownership at the end of December 2023, applied against the April 7, 2025 share count. The FMR footnote is internally inconsistent: it gives ownership 'As of December 29, 2023' but cites a Schedule 13G/A 'filed April 7, 2025'; asOf follows the stated as-of date, but the figure's true date is uncertain. GEOGRAPHY: the four regional streaming revenues sum exactly to total revenues of $39,000,966 thousand; 2024 streaming revenues include $124 million of hedging gains (stated in Note 2). Stock comp is the cash-flow line; the 10-K says the company grants non-qualified stock options to employees monthly.

footprint.notes: Netflix reports memberships and employees only by its four regions (UCAN, EMEA, LATAM, APAC); no country or state figures. Each region row joins two passages of the same 10-K with ' … ': the Note 1 membership table and the Item 1 employee sentence. Memberships are printed in thousands and stored multiplied by 1,000 (301.6 million in total). Only UCAN carries a country list because the filing names it 'United States and Canada'; the other regions' member countries are not defined in the filing. Sites: HQ and LA from 10-K Item 2 (which gives no production-hub list); production hubs from Netflix's own news pages (Albuquerque 2024, Shepperton 2019, Tres Cantos 2022). Other hubs (e.g. Toronto, Fort Monmouth NJ plans) were not checked against a company page and are omitted.
